evidence.quoted_text:
if (entry.path.split('/').includes('node_modules')) {
      throw new Error(`ratchet git: refusing head-controlled node_modules path '${entry.path}'`);
evidence.reason: The supplied code refuses only the exact lowercase segment via `entry.path.split('/').includes('node_modules')`. A head-controlled path such as `Node_Modules/@types/x/index.d.ts` passes this check; on a default case-insensitive macOS/Windows filesystem it is written as the effective `node_modules` directory, defeating the stated purpose in the docstring at lines 525-527 that a tracked `node_modules` segment be refused so `tsc` cannot resolve head-controlled declarations. This is an implementation gap in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
